title: Obsolete Feature-Policy header present
description: The response sends `Feature-Policy`, the header that Permissions-Policy replaced. Current browsers ignore it, so a deployment that believes it restricted a powerful feature through this header has in fact declared nothing, and the two headers can disagree while both are present.
remediation: Move every directive to Permissions-Policy, which uses `feature=(allow-list)` syntax, and remove Feature-Policy once the translation is verified.
limitation: One header value. The rule reports the obsolete header; it does not compare it with any Permissions-Policy that is also present and cannot say which features end up allowed.
